name: slop-factory
description: Generate a new TypeScript project from composable modules: one quality gate, a coverage floor, layered config, and agent rules.

scripts.build: node --import tsx scripts/clean-dist.ts && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node --import tsx scripts/copy-dist-assets.ts
scripts.check:all: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.examples:check: npm run build && node --import tsx scripts/examples.ts check
scripts.examples:refresh: npm run build && node --import tsx scripts/examples.ts refresh
scripts.generate: npm run build && node bin/slop-factory.mjs generate
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run check:all && npm run test:prompts && npm run test:layout && npm run test:packaging && npm run examples:check && npm run verify
scripts.test:layout: npm run build && vitest run --project layout
scripts.test:prompts: npm run build && vitest run --project prompts
scripts.verify: npm run build && vitest run --project generation
